items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I was very much influenced by Louis and you can hear that Louis beat in Lester.

ctx.x: doing too, and loving Lester. Like, For instance, how Billie Holiday, above everybody, Billie interpreted Lester, particularly felt what he was doing. But it was something unique and different and in after years, as one hears the various records it becomes clear that there is a relationship between you two and I am not talking about one playing like another and or one having heard the other, but it's you might say in the same family.

Yes, well, that's very true because many people have said that we play a little alike. I am not too sure about that, but I only know that we were influenced by the same people. You can hear -- in fact, I have written about this in the first book called You Don't Look Like A Musician -- I was very much influenced by Louis and you can hear that Louis beat in Lester.
